verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is user-level sharing controls: password-protected files on business plans, editor vs. viewer access, and customizable sharing links. None of these shows admin-governed, org-wide policy over external sharing. missing for 10: org-level admin controls restricting sharing outside the team, domain allowlists/blocklists, admin-enforced link policies (e.g., team-only links, expiry defaults), admin console documentation, independent corroboration.
